brief: Build me a small habit tracker app from scratch in this project. It loads the user's habits from GET /api/habits, which returns [{ id, name, streak }], and shows each habit's name with its streak (for example "Read: 3 days"). Users add a habit with a field labelled "Habit name" and an "Add habit" button: a blank name shows "Name is required" and sends nothing; otherwise it sends POST /api/habits with { name } and shows the habit the server returns. Each habit has a "Done today" button, named for its habit for screen readers (for example "Done today: Read"), that sends POST /api/habits/:id/check and shows the habit the server returns with its new streak. Show a loading message while habits load and an error message if they cannot be loaded. Add tests.
